anchor_value: USD cost/fair-value columns in source schedule

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Country/Security/Industry/Company | Investment Type | Interest Term * | Interest Rate | Maturity/ Dissolution Date | Principal Amount, Par Value or Shares ** | Cost | Percentage of Net Assets *** | Fair Value
Ancora Bidco PTY LTD (6) | Unitranche First Lien Term Loan | B + 500, 50 Floor | 8.60 % | 11/2030 | AUD 3,462 | 3,366 | 0.8 % | 3,497

findings.detail: Foreign currency labels such as AUD are principal amount units, while the Cost and Fair Value columns are USD-denominated; cost_currency was populated from the principal/unit currency.

rationale: FX03 is a real row-level data error. In the raw schedule header, principal amount is a separate column from Cost and Fair Value. The Ancora row shows AUD 3,462 in the principal amount column, but cost and fair value are separate numeric schedule-dollar values; the Australia subtotal explicitly prefixes the Cost and Fair Value totals with $. Therefore the stored non-USD cost_currency reflects a principal-currency-to-cost-currency extraction/mapping error, not a true non-USD cost valuation field.
